steps.note: Step 1: go to the list page.
Step 2: click Open child in new tab.
Step 2: the NEW tab shows PAGE linked (needs to target the new tab, e.g. via surface.tab).
Step 3: enter draft note in Echo input in the new tab.
Step 3: the note appears next to the field.
Step 4: back on the original tab, MULTI-TAB HOME is still shown (needs to target the first tab).

must_not: Opening the child page with a plain goTo to multi-tab-child.html instead of clicking the link (that skips the documented step).
